meta.temperature_K_convention: Pair is [min_K, max_K]. Use null for max to mean no upper bound. A number always means that number — there is no magic threshold. (999 is still read as no-bound for older files, but is deprecated: write null.)

species.description: Single-species genus. Grows on airless volcanic bodies close to a nebula; no star, gravity or planet-type preference.

conditions.location_requirement: Nebula: 93 % of 23,651 Bark Mound systems lie within 150 ly of a nebula, 100 % within 300 ly (edastro codex-data; background 4-7 %). Evaluated per body: a system beyond the radius is demoted to the unlikely tier rather than removed.
matchContextNotes: Measured: 4,551 Bioforge sightings at 89-440 K, up to 1.37 g, host stars spread F/A/M/K/G, 21 regions; no volcanism on 0.2 %.

6.6 % of the Spansh dump's Bark Mound bodies have a thin atmosphere: carbon dioxide 5.7 % (nearly all High Metal Content), sulphur dioxide 0.5 %, argon-rich and carbon dioxide-rich 0.2 % each. Listed since 2026-10-07: demoted, they were 8 of the 42 known-spawn Bark Mound bodies the app hid (precision sample, new export).
Added 2026-09-25 after Tegnae HT-Z d13-1 1 a (airless rocky, silicate vapour geysers) grew Bark Mounds and the app had no row for them.
